semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Rehm Thermal Systems specializes in manufacturing equipment for soldering and coating processes, which are relevant to the semiconductor and photovoltaic industries.
summary: Rehm Thermal Systems is a manufacturer of energy-efficient reflow soldering systems and coating equipment tailored for the electronics and photovoltaics sectors. With a focus on innovative technologies, the company provides solutions that enhance manufacturing processes, ensuring high quality and efficiency.
capabilities: Reflow soldering systems with convection and condensation
Customizable manufacturing equipment for soldering and coating
Vacuum module integration for soldering processes

regional_presence.China: Rehm Thermal Systems established a manufacturing facility in China in 2008 to enhance its production capabilities.
